paths.plans: uri! @desc(活躍開發計畫目錄路徑 (綁定 workflow.plans://，預設 project://plans))
paths.archived: uri! @desc(歷史封存計畫目錄路徑 (綁定 workflow.archived://，預設 project://plans/archived))
paths.docs: uri! @desc(專案系統知識庫文檔目錄路徑 (綁定 workflow.docs://，預設 project://docs))
paths.roadmap: uri? = project://plans/roadmap @desc(長期技術路線圖與待辦目錄路徑 (綁定 workflow.roadmap://))

release_targets: list[str]? = [] @desc(工作流編譯物化之目標環境清單 (如 antigravity, claude, codex))
enable_agents_md: bool? = true @desc(是否於專案根目錄生成受託管 AGENTS.md 規範檔)
enable_project_changelog: bool? = true @desc(是否啟用專案根目錄 CHANGELOG.md 結案同步維護)
